versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the voice2need skill.
- Researches group needs from community discussions, using only authorized sources and full conversation context.
- Distinguishes between wishes, behavior, suggestions, and actions; all findings are traceable to exact sources.
- Bundled offline demo for safe demonstration; not representative of real communities.
- Outputs evidence-backed findings, counterexamples, fourteen research answers, and collection coverage details.
- No setup required from users beyond describing their field and research question.
